fig1_projectile_range.svg: Trajectories from the module's projectile() launched at 20 m/s for 30, 45 and 60 degrees (circles mark the landing range R, triangles the apex). The range v0^2 sin(2 theta)/g is largest at 45 degrees; 30 and 60 give the same range.
fig2_circular_accel_split.svg: Uniform circular motion (R=2, omega=3) decomposed by the module's speed, tangential_acceleration and normal_acceleration. The speed is constant (R omega=6) so a_T is essentially zero, while the entire acceleration is normal: a_N = v^2/R = 18.
